entries.subject: Donaldson thesis physical extents and nominal pole
entries.finding: Retained intake decision: Table 4.4, Model 1; section 4.3.1.2; Table 4.5 supplies axis ratios a/b=1.21 and b/c=1.24. A smooth ellipsoid uses these proportions; no original convex mesh or local terrain is claimed.

entries.subject: SEPPCoN thermal radius as the display scale
entries.finding: The adopted thermal radius is 4.79 km. Using it as a volume-equivalent display radius is an explicit scaling convention; it does not measure a volume or absolute axis lengths.

entries.subject: Model 2
entries.finding: Retained intake decision: Rejected by the thesis as inconsistent with stable principal-axis rotation. Not prepared.
entries.revisitWhen: A revised physical solution resolves the stable-rotation inconsistency identified in the thesis.
